theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_ST (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).ST
    !! w = Option.map (fun st => if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then mvcc.setRestore st else st) (σ.ST
    !! w)

theorem mvcc.WsOk.restoreSt {σ : mvcc.WsState} (h : mvcc.WsOk σ) (Lr : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.WsOk
    (σ.restoreSt Lr)

theorem mvcc.memberRes_restoreSt (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (hset :
    σ.settled) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (hst : σ.ST !! w = some st) :
    mvcc.memberRes γ 1 σ w st ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx σ.Lmu ⊢ mvcc.memberRes γ 1 (σ.restoreSt Lr) w
    (if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then mvcc.setRestore st else st)

theorem mvcc.rs_union_insert (Wu T : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (k : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (h :
    Wu !! k = none) : <[k := r]>(Wu ∪ T) = Wu ∪ <[k := r]>T

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_Wu (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).Wu
    !! w = (σ.Wu !! w).or (σ.Ws !! w)

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_E (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).E
    !! w = Option.map (fun e => if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then (e.fst, (Option.map (fun st =>
    sint.nat st.minRev) (σ.ST !! w)).getD e.snd) else e) (σ.E !! w)

def mvcc.WsState.restoreSt (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.WsState :=
  { Lmu := Lr, Ws := ∅, Wu := σ.Wu ∪ σ.Ws,
    ST := mvcc.gmapMapK (fun w st => if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then mvcc.setRestore st else st) σ.ST, Wo := σ.Wo,
    M := σ.M,
    E :=
      mvcc.gmapMapK
        (fun w e =>
          if (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true then (e.fst, (Option.map (fun st => sint.nat st.minRev) (σ.ST !! w)).getD e.snd)
          else e)
        σ.E,
    vs := σ.vs, vbs := σ.vbs, VB := σ.VB }

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_settled {σ : mvcc.WsState} (hs : σ.settled) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (hL :
    List.length σ.Lmu ≤ List.length Lr) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).settled

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_live (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) : (σ.restoreSt
    Lr).live w ↔ σ.live w

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_victimOf (σ : mvcc.WsState) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (w : Loc) : (σ.restoreSt
    Lr).victimOf w = σ.victimOf w

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_unsRst {σ : mvcc.WsState} (hs : σ.unsRst) (Lr : mvcc.Log) (hL :
    List.length σ.Lmu ≤ List.length Lr) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).unsRst

def mvcc.setRestore (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  { minRev := st.minRev, victim := st.victim, compacted := st.compacted, restore := true, ch := st.ch }

theorem mvcc.WsState.restoreSt_srBelow {σ : mvcc.WsState} (hs : σ.srBelow (List.length σ.Lmu)) (Lr :
    mvcc.Log) (hL : List.length σ.Lmu ≤ List.length Lr) : (σ.restoreSt Lr).srBelow (List.length
    (σ.restoreSt Lr).Lmu)
